title: DSPy Core Framework
summary: This module establishes the foundational architecture for building and optimizing Language Model programs in DSPy. It defines core program structures, manages interactions with LMs and external tools, and provides mechanisms for structured data handling and task definition.

nodes.label: DSPy Program Structure
nodes.title: Core Program Building Blocks
nodes.description: Defines the fundamental classes for DSPy programs, including module hierarchy, parameter management, and the core execution logic for LM interactions.

nodes.label: LM Task Definition (Signatures)
nodes.title: Language Model Task Specification
nodes.description: Provides the mechanism to formally define the inputs, outputs, and instructions for any Language Model task, guiding the LM's behavior within DSPy programs.

nodes.label: Data I/O & LM Adapters
nodes.title: Structured Data & LM Interaction
nodes.description: Manages how DSPy programs interact with Language Models, handling prompt construction, response parsing, and integrating native LM features like function calling.

nodes.label: Custom Data Types
nodes.title: Extensible Data Structures
nodes.description: Enables the definition and handling of diverse structured and multimodal data types (e.g., Audio, Image, Tool) for seamless integration into LM inputs and outputs.

nodes.label: External Tool Integration
nodes.title: LLM Tooling & Sandboxing
nodes.description: Provides primitives for integrating and executing external tools and functions within a sandboxed environment, enabling LLMs to interact with dynamic data and services.

nodes.label: Language Model (LLM)
nodes.title: External Language Model
nodes.description: The underlying large language model that DSPy programs interact with to perform tasks, abstracted by DSPy's LM clients for consistent access.

nodes.label: External Services & APIs
nodes.title: External Systems & APIs
nodes.description: Represents various external systems, databases, or APIs that DSPy programs might interact with via tools or custom data types for enhanced functionality.

groups.label: Core Abstractions
groups.title: Fundamental DSPy Building Blocks
groups.description: Defines the essential components for structuring DSPy programs and specifying Language Model tasks, forming the backbone of any DSPy application.

groups.label: LM Interaction & Data Layer
groups.title: Managing LM Communication & Data
groups.description: Handles the interface with Language Models, including prompt formatting, response parsing, and robust support for diverse structured and multimodal data types.

groups.label: External Integration
groups.title: Connecting to External Capabilities
groups.description: Enables DSPy programs to leverage external tools and services, extending their capabilities beyond the Language Model itself through sandboxed execution.

groups.label: External Systems
groups.title: Dependencies Outside DSPy
groups.description: Represents the external Language Models and other services that the DSPy framework interacts with to perform its functions and extend its reach.
